title: A Sigil for the Spire
author: Mara Marchetti
blurb: Rosalind Winterbourne, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
